events.title: Blonde Neon • The Wanna Be-52s [B-52s tribute] • Precious [The Pretenders]
events.description:
21 & Over | $20 Advance, $25 Day Of Show | Blonde Neon is your ticket back to when music made you move without thinking twice. Blondie, Heart, Go-Go’s, Pat Benatar—if it’s got that ’80s magic, they’ve mastered it.We’re talking synth-heavy, dance-worthy, female-fronted obsessed. The kind of obsessed that means they’ve nailed every keyboard line, every harmony, every beat that made the decade legendary. Warning: Spontaneous dancing is guaranteed.

The Wanna Be-52’s is Portland’s tribute to the original post-punk / new wave / greatest party band ever!
Precious: The Pretenders Experience brings the cool, defiant spirit to life with sharp musicianship and real attitude. Fronted by Twig Sullivan channeling the iconic swagger and voice of Chrissie Hynde, the band delivers the hits with grit, soul, and zero karaoke vibes. Based in Portland, Oregon, Precious captures the raw energy, punk edge, and melodic punch that made The Pretenders timeless.

– – – – –

We’re helping the Newberg High School 80s grads celebrate their class reunion!!

events.title: My Chemical Fauxmance [MCR tribute] • Business Of Misery [Paramore]
events.description:
21 & Over | $20 Advance, $25 Day Of Show | My Chemical Fauxmance brings the chaos and spectacle of My Chemical Romance to stages across the Pacific Northwest. Fueled by the millennial generation who lived through the golden age of emo, the band recreates the emotion, storytelling, and theatrical drama that made MCR legendary.Every show is unpredictable: explosive energy, unhinged front-person antics, atmospheric visuals, and a live crowd screaming every word like it’s 2006 all over again. Experience a performance of the entire BLACK PARADE album as part of the 20th anniversary celebration!

Business Of Misery is a group of life-long fans, from the humble beginnings of warped tour shiragirl stages to the sold out stadiums of the 2020’s. They take pride in bringing you an homage to exactly what makes Paramore special: high-energy performances, incredible songs, supportive spaces in the music scene for girls/women/LGBTQ+/people of color, and most importantly a show where you can sing your HEART out.
